lens: Generative-SVG artist + rendering-performance engineer (composited-only animation, deterministic output)

<picture> AVIF/WebP/JPEG at 480/768/1024/1600 via tools/process-images.mjs (sharp from scratch, EXIF stripped, licence manifest media/photos.json)

gates: cd $WT/site && node tools/dev-setup.mjs --devtools   # once it exists (W1 build); before that: tsc --typeRoots /opt/node-tools/node_modules/@types
node build.mjs --offline-images --out=$OUT && SITE_DIST=$OUT node tools/check-all.mjs --no-build [--strict-redirects from W1 ia on]
PORT=$PORT SITE_DIST=$OUT node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --trace off
node tools/a11y.mjs --themes=dark,light --widths=320,1440 --motion=off,on   # once qa lands; until then axe via the global helper
